name: figure-skill
description: Evidence-aware scientific figure generation, editing, provenance, and QA for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, edit, trace, and QA scientific figures.
interface.longDescription: Turn research text, experiment data, and existing figures into editable SVG, draw.io, PDF, and PNG outputs with human review, provenance, and structural QA.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable scientific figure from my research inputs.
Turn my experiment data into a provenance-tracked plot.
Review and repair this figure without inventing evidence.
